title: Choosing a University Major
paragraphs: Faris menyukai sastra, tetapi keluarganya berharap ia belajar teknik. Selama tahun terakhir SMA, memilih jurusan terasa sangat sulit baginya. Ia berbicara jujur dengan ayahnya. Ayahnya bercerita bahwa dahulu ia ingin belajar sejarah, tetapi merasa tertekan untuk memilih teknik.

Percakapan itu memberi Faris keberanian untuk memilih sastra. Beberapa kerabat perlu waktu untuk memahami keputusannya, tetapi ayahnya mendukungnya. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, Faris bekerja sebagai penulis yang karyanya diterbitkan. Ia sering mengingat bahwa satu percakapan jujur membantunya memilih jalannya sendiri.
answerKey: Faris loved literature, but his family expected him to study engineering. During his final year of high school, choosing a major felt very difficult. He spoke honestly with his father. His father shared that he had once wanted to study history but had felt pressure to choose engineering instead. The conversation gave Faris courage to choose literature. Some relatives needed time to understand his decision, but his father supported him. Years later, Faris worked as a published writer. He often remembered that one honest conversation had helped him choose his own path.
